method: Web search (33 queries, recorded verbatim below) Cupertino first, then the 10-15 mile ring: Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Campbell, Los Gatos, Los Altos, Mountain View, Palo Alto/Stanford, Saratoga, Milpitas, West San Jose, Fremont/Newark. Every candidate name was screened against a 1,153-key norm(name)|norm(city) index built from data/lunch_specials.json (877 rows) and data/lunch_rejected.json (273 rows) before any page was opened.

queries.query: Cupertino restaurant "lunch special" menu price official website
queries.result: Home Eat Toast menu (used); Yelp Cupertino lunch-special list (leads; 24 names screened, all already in master)

queries.query: "lunch special" Cupertino CA 95014 restaurant Monday-Friday 11am price
queries.result: Home Eat again; Yelp cheap-lunch list (leads only)

queries.query: Sunnyvale restaurant "lunch special" price menu official site 2026
queries.result: Sunnyvale Chamber Restaurant Week page (event, dated); Yelp Sunnyvale list (leads)

queries.query: Santa Clara restaurant "lunch special" menu price official website
queries.result: The Hut Santa Clara menu (already L112); Home Eat Santa Clara; Chungdam lunch menu (already L553)

queries.query: Campbell CA restaurant "lunch special" price menu official website downtown
queries.result: La Pizzeria Campbell 'Lunch Special 11 AM to 4 PM' (already L226); Yelp Campbell list

queries.query: Los Gatos restaurant "lunch special" price menu official
queries.result: Wine Cellar Los Gatos menu (already L488); Yelp Los Gatos list

queries.query: Los Altos restaurant "lunch special" price menu official website 2026
queries.result: Los Altos Taqueria 'Lunchtime Specials served 11AM to 3PM Monday - Friday' + 'Muy Rapido Lunch $7.99' (Goose Creek SC trap, see LUNCH-FLAG-139)

queries.query: Mountain View restaurant "lunch special" price menu official Castro Street
queries.result: OpenTable Don Giovanni (lunch specials quoted from reviews, not primary); Reddit r/mountainview thread (leads only)

queries.query: new restaurant opened 2026 Cupertino lunch special menu
queries.result: Cupertino 2025-26 openings: Hometown Kitchen, Changsha Rice Noodles, Lee & Bai, Jade Xiang Yue, Mifen Yo, Calcutta Chaat & Chinese, Friendship BBQ, Urban Momo, Koi Palace Contempo, Pau Pau, Amakara

queries.query: "lunch special" Sunnyvale OR Cupertino OR "Santa Clara" restaurant "11:00 AM" "2:30 PM" price
queries.result: Sunnyvale Chamber Restaurant Week again; Benihana Cupertino page (already L01); Yelp cheap-lunch list

queries.query: "lunch special" menu site restaurant Campbell OR "Los Gatos" OR Saratoga official "served" Monday price 2026
queries.result: saratoga.com '2 For $22 Lunch' - Saratoga Springs, NEW YORK (trap, LUNCH-FLAG-167); Wine Cellar menu

queries.query: "Lunch Special" toast.site Cupertino OR Sunnyvale OR "Santa Clara" restaurant menu price
queries.result: Local Kitchens Cupertino 'Lunch Specials (Includes side and drink)' (used); Home Eat Cupertino + Santa Clara (used); Yelp list

queries.query: Pau Pau Cupertino restaurant menu lunch special; Amakara Cupertino; Mesob Sunnyvale lunch
queries.result: Pau Pizza (Hawaii/East Bay chain, different business); Amakara and Mesob not confirmed as separate local businesses - not added

queries.query: Eureka Restaurant Cupertino "$13" lunch specials official menu hours
queries.result: Yelp Cupertino business highlight '$13 Lunch Specials ... Every Day, Open till 3pm' (already L33)

queries.query: "Hometown Kitchen" Cupertino menu lunch special hours official
queries.result: Hometown Kitchen is Milpitas (1245 Jacklin Rd), not Cupertino; a third-party FAQ claims lunch specials with rice and soup (not usable)

queries.query: "Changsha Rice Noodles" Cupertino 10911 Wolfe menu lunch special price
queries.result: Official site changsha-mifen.com (no priced menu, no lunch special) -> rejection

queries.query: "Koi Palace" Cupertino dim sum lunch menu hours price
queries.result: Koi Palace Contempo Cupertino 19369 Stevens Creek Blvd Ste 100; dim sum menu only, no priced lunch special -> rejection

queries.query: "Jade Xiang Yue" OR "Lee & Bai" OR "Mifen Yo" Cupertino menu price lunch
queries.result: Fantuan/DoorDash price lists for Jade Xiang Yue and Mifen Yo (third-party) -> rejections

queries.query: "Mifen Yo" Cupertino official site menu order online 19066 Stevens Creek
queries.result: mifenyo.com referenced by a listing; no restaurant-controlled priced menu found -> rejection

queries.query: "Lee & Bai" bao Cupertino Sunnyvale official website menu hours lunch combo
queries.result: Sunnyvale 1661 Hollenbeck Ave; listing hours only, no lunch special -> rejection

queries.query: "Curry Hyuga" Cupertino lunch special price hours official site
queries.result: curryhyuga.com hours block + the restaurant's Toast item page (hours) - used for L12

queries.query: Masakali Indian Cuisine Cupertino lunch special menu price hours official
queries.result: Listings only; Canadian namesake review 'there was no lunch specials' - LUNCH-FLAG-168

queries.query: "Olarn Thai" Cupertino lunch special price menu hours official
queries.result: OpenTable lunch 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM listing; menupix 'reported as permanently closed' - LUNCH-FLAG-169

queries.query: "Duan's Kitchen" OR "Mandarin Gourmet" OR "Harumi Sushi" Cupertino lunch special menu price hours
queries.result: Listing hours only; no restaurant-controlled lunch special found

queries.query: toasttab.com "Lunch Special" Cupertino OR Sunnyvale OR Campbell OR "Los Altos" restaurant menu price
queries.result: Local Kitchens Cupertino (used), Home Eat Cupertino/Santa Clara, Saravanaa Bhavan Sunnyvale, Los Gatos Parkside, Kailash Parbat Santa Clara

queries.query: order.toasttab.com "Lunch Specials" Sunnyvale OR "Santa Clara" OR "Mountain View" OR "Los Gatos" restaurant menu prices
queries.result: Home Eat Santa Clara, Anjappar Santa Clara (no lunch special section), Los Gatos Parkside (dinner only), Kailash Parbat Santa Clara

queries.query: "lunch specials" menu cupertino restaurant "order online" price combo 2026 site
queries.result: Local Kitchens Cupertino FULL MENU confirmation + Home Eat Cupertino full menu

queries.query: BJ's Restaurant Brewhouse "lunch specials" menu price weekdays hours official
queries.result: Third-party BJ's menu page and a 2023 shopping-centre promo: $13 lunch specials Mon-Fri 11 AM - 3 PM; not a restaurant-controlled current page

queries.query: Cupertino "lunch special" menu price Kikusushi OR Azuma OR "Kong Tofu" OR Wooga lunch hours
queries.result: Menupages (Grubhub-powered) Azuma 'Azuma Daily Special (L) $18.95'; Kikusushi menupages listing - third-party, not usable as verification

queries.query: Cupertino restaurant own website "lunch special" "Monday" "Friday" "11:30" "2:30" price menu
queries.result: EatDrinkLA (Los Angeles) weekday lunch specials list - out of area

queries.query: "Siam Station" Cupertino address 20956 Homestead official; "The City Fish" Cupertino 21678 Stevens Creek official
queries.result: Corroborates the retained addresses for L07 and L355 against the batch-13b duplicates - LUNCH-FLAG-161

queries.query: "Hometown Kitchen" Milpitas Jacklin order online menu lunch special price
queries.result: Beyond Menu, OrderSpoon and Postmates priced menus for 1245 Jacklin Rd: no lunch-special section -> rejection

queries.query: "Calcutta" Cupertino restaurant chaat Chinese order online menu lunch special price
queries.result: calcuttachaatbakery.com 'Daily Lunch Spacial' $13.99-$17.99 (used, LUNCH-FLAG-165) and calcuttachaat.com outlet list (Milpitas/Fremont) -> new row
